3. Reason (R) directly explains Assertion (A).
Hence Option C is correct.
Hence, option (D) is the correct choice.

questionText:

In ancient Persia, he noted four classes: knights and princes; monks and fire-priests; lawyers, physicians, astronomers and other scientists; and peasants and artisans. In other words, he attempted to suggest that social divisions were not unique to India. At the same time, Al-Biruni disapproved of the Brahmanical notion of pollution. He remarked that everything which falls into a state of impurity strives and succeeds in regaining its original condition of purity. The sun cleanses the air, and the salt in the sea prevents the water from becoming foul. If it were not so, insisted Al-Biruni, life on earth would have been impossible.
